posts.author: Coffeeccubus
posts.body: So I purchased RPG Maker MV a while ago before everything updated. Komodo Plaza is SUPER confusing to navigate, and I purchased both that and an asset pack. Is there any way to find an area on where exactly all of these products are put in? Both here and Komodo Plaza?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Don't they send you E-Mails with like instructions? There's no library on the plaza as far as I'm aware.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Yeah...if you don't still have the e-mail with the purchase number and download link, but you still have access to the e-mail, you can contact customer service.
If you don't have access to the e-mail you used, I don't know if there's anything they can do.

posts.author: Coffeeccubus
posts.body: That is kind of dumb, honestly, they REALLY should add some easier way to track all purchases. Its kind of dumb that you need to keep an email or something for purchases. ITs a huge hindrance.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
If you say so. I have e-mails for software that I purchased over 20 years ago, comes right up as soon as I type it into my search.
But regardless, there's nothing that anyone on the forum can do about it.

posts.body: If you don't want to have to deal with emails, there's always the option of buying on steam.
